title: SCRIPE-Frontend RBAC, Dotted FLS & Partial CRM MVVM Walkthrough
intro: Follow how Next.js 16 prevents tenant superadmin spoofing, scopes Role and UserGroup pickers, synchronizes live principals, and submits FLS-safe partial CRM updates.
outro: Client route guards, RBAC editors, Zustand state, and CRM services stay locked to backend FLS and 389-permission tenant pools.

points.title: Route & Manifest Gatekeeping
points.text: RouteGuard matches every path against PAGE_PERMISSIONS and synced menus before rendering, aligning /audit, /security, /sso/continue, and /entitlements/payouts.
points.caption: Zero unprotected route drift against backend menus

points.title: Platform vs Tenant SuperAdmin
points.text: isPlatformSuperAdminUser strictly requires !user?.tenantId, eliminating Supervisor substring matching and username spoofing inside tenant sessions.
points.caption: Tenant admins rely on live effective permissions

points.title: Roles Matrix & Permission Config
points.text: PermissionConfigDialog preserves full dotted resources like crm.opportunities, blocks all_tenants for tenant roles, and locks system-protected SA policies.
points.caption: Dotted resource keys stay intact on role saves

points.title: UserGroups Restrictions Studio
points.text: SetRestrictionsDialog clones drafts immutably, isolates per-row useId() datalists, strips platformOnly catalog permissions, and warns truthfully on required fields.
points.caption: Additive UserGroup caps never expose host permissions

points.title: Immediate Principal & Cache Sync
points.text: After any RBAC or entitlement edit, syncCurrentSessionAuthorization refetches /auth/admin/principal, overwrites [] cleanly, and purges stale navigation queries.
points.caption: Revocations apply instantly across open UI sessions

points.title: Partial CRM Update & Close
points.text: updateOpportunity and closeOpportunity omit undefined restricted fields such as currencyCode and dealKind so backend FLS preserves existing DB values.
points.caption: Slices 6A & 6C prevent false 403 FieldRestricted blocks
